name: guardhouse
description: Connect local Codex to self-hosted Guardhouse through native MCP/OAuth, then inspect, audit, integrate, and safely configure supported applications and visual branding.

interface.longDescription: The official Guardhouse beta for local OpenAI Codex hosts, developed and maintained by LegioSoft. A Guardhouse administrator must enable the integration and register the stable OAuth callback before sign-in. Connect to your own Guardhouse instance through native MCP OAuth, inspect connection status, switch instances, inspect and audit applications, integrate local projects, and safely configure supported browser-application fields and visual sign-in branding. Arbitrary self-hosted connections require a local Codex host.
defaultPrompt: Show my current Guardhouse instance and connection status, and how to disconnect, reconnect, or switch instances.
Review and update my Guardhouse sign-in branding.

publication.release_notes: 0.2.0 beta candidate: current-instance status and connection controls, stable OAuth callback reuse across instances, application inspection and audits, guarded browser configuration, and visual branding workflows. Corrects incomplete-list replacement handling and custom HTML identifier selection. Requires local Codex execution and administrator-enabled Guardhouse integration.
